findings.problem: The sentence uses abandonar in the infinitive after voy a, but the card's own verb must appear conjugated.
findings.fix: example.es: Mi papá nos abandonó cuando yo era niño. / example.en: My dad abandoned us when I was a kid.

back.es: to abandon, to leave (someone or something) behind, to give up
back.example: I'm never going to abandon you.

note: Dejar can also mean "to leave", but for the prompt "to abandon" abandonar is the clear answer, so the card needs no hint.
